Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 6,957.08 up 60.08 points January 09, 2019, 04:45:11 PM EDT By NASDAQ.com News Shutterstock photo
Wednesday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 6,957.08. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.35 billion.
Advancers stocks led declining by 1.91 to 1 ratio. There were 2043 advancers and 1069 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 20 stocks reached a 52 week high and 6 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed up .75% for the day; a total of 48.84 points. The current value is 6,600.69. Sirius XM Holdings Inc. ( SIRI ) had the largest percent change down (-4.57%) while Intuitive Surgical, Inc. ( ISRG ) had the largest percent change gain rising 7.06%. The Dow Jones index closed up .39% for the day; a total of 91.67 points. The current value is 23,879.12. Verizon Communications Inc.
